answer: Sybil resistance derives from reputation’s exponential temporal half-life: an identity must sustain honest, reciprocated service over time to retain influence. In the EigenTrust matrix, temporal decay and reciprocity-weighted transitivity keep dormant or collusive links from amplifying scores. A freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality, so its echo, sonnet, or onyx of fabricated endorsements cannot carry it through consensus.
